summary: The evidence gate's dbt bars, set from the measurement in #2418: on DuckDB-style projects, jaffle_shop's proof rate stays at or above 25 % of its declared tests, so it can't regress. Warehouse dialects have no read-rate bar for 1.0: the scoped statement says sverify-dbt reads DuckDB SQL dbt projects.
note: Sets the bar the 2026-11-22 gate ruling left to the maintainer. The measurement at the time: 5 of jaffle_shop's 20 tests proved. BigQuery and other warehouse dialects are out of scope until a lift exists (Snowflake and Spark: #866).
